mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 65 degrees with light drizzle by Verona Area High School. Tonight, the moon is in its First Quarter, and the ISS will be visible for five minutes starting at 7:40 PM, moving from the Northwest to the Northeast. Expect an overnight low of 60 degrees with rain likely.
City maintenance crews are beginning chip seal road treatments on September 23. Expect lane closures between 9 AM and 3 PM on East Verona Avenue, Cross Country Road, and in the Liberty Business Park.

We have a busy couple of days! Today, you can check out the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival, the Dane County Farmers Market, and live music at various local spots. Tomorrow, head over to Badger Prairie County Park for the Bike the Barns fundraiser.
In a serious incident on September 10, officers responded to a burglary in the 600 block of Hunters Cove Way where a shot was fired; the suspect was apprehended at the scene.
The Culver's of Verona location is currently closed for a remodel, so they will not be serving their flavor of the day today. Please check their website for updates on when they will reopen.
